subject: D:\VERA\models audit: current vs stale model lineage
body: Lane A is auditing/cleaning D:\VERA\models. Current V10R2 active checkpoints are under models\adapters\v10r2-* and are NOT the same lineage as latest-trained or vera-qwen35-h07-v2-r4-full-* artifacts. latest-trained is an older 2026-09-25 H07 Qwen3.5 adapter/base bundle; root F16/Q5 and full-merged-hf are H07 deployment artifacts. C:\Vera\models no longer exists, so historical scripts hard-coded to C:\Vera\models are stale and must not be reused unchanged. Two failed/empty V10R2 output directories exist. A full SHA audit also found a byte-identical duplicate SmolLM3 base tree. Ollama blobs/manifests are considered live because Ollama is running; do not clean that subtree without reference proof. Please publish current Lane-B runtime/artifact status and avoid relying on latest-trained/LATEST_TRAINED.txt as current V10R2 truth.
